about: Today's Sky Devotion for La Porte, Indiana, picked each morning by what the sky is doing (devotion/sky.js). By La Porte Weather Now. Scripture: KJV (public domain). Weather: National Weather Service.
forecastLine: Today: Sunny, high near 68°. Tonight: Mostly Clear, low around 48°.

entry.kjv: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
entry.text: Some days the weather is just right, and it's hard not to call it very good. God called His creation very good long before we did. Get outside today if you can, and enjoy what He made.
